proof_scope: Instruction-only skill contract for focused verbosity cleanup, review-only behavior under ambiguous write access, test-economy discipline, and concise final response endings.

claims.proves: The skill declares routing/composition frontmatter, preserves review-only defaults unless write access is explicit, protects behavior and cleanup/error semantics from over-aggressive shortening, requires the smallest useful test coverage for distinct behavior, and gives concise final response endings for changed and no-change reviews.
claims.does_not_prove: A model will always identify every verbose construct, semantic correctness of a future cleanup, or project-specific tests outside this instruction file.

cases.name: ambiguous-write-access-defaults-to-review-only
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text=Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
assert 'operate in review-only mode. Do not edit files.' in text
assert 'If write access is ambiguous, default to review-only.' in text
assert 'You have exclusive write access' in text
print('WRITE_MODE_OK')
PY

cases.name: preserves-behavior-and-error-semantics
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text=Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
for phrase in ('preserves behavior, error signals, cleanup semantics', 'error context and `cause` chains', 'cleanup and cancellation semantics', 'no swallowing errors to make a branch shorter'):
    assert phrase in text, phrase
print('PRESERVATION_OK')
PY

cases.name: test-economy-keeps-distinct-behavior-coverage
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text=Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
for phrase in ('Keep one test per distinct behavior or risk', 'Prefer the cheapest layer that catches the bug', 'Before deleting a test, name the behavior claim it protects', 'run the narrowed test file and the relevant suite'):
    assert phrase in text, phrase
print('TEST_ECONOMY_OK')
PY

cases.name: final-response-endings-are-explicit
command: grep -F 'Fixed [N] issue(s). Ready for another review.' ../SKILL.md && grep -F 'No issues found.' ../SKILL.md

stdout_contains: Fixed [N] issue(s). Ready for another review.
